issue.title: [i18n] future 2.x plan

labels.name: area: i18n
labels.description: Issues related to localization and internationalization

issue.body:
Features planned for 2.0:
- [x] gender
- [x] pluralization
- [x] runtime compiler
- [x] offline compiler
- [x] xliff support
- [x] hash message ids
- [x] i18n messages

fix issues:
- [x] xmb/xtb support https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/9067
- [x] do not extract empty msgs https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/8802
- [ ] allow escaping ICU messages - #9286
- [x] fix markup for plural/gender https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/9072 (PR #9283)
- [x] improve the extractor https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/9071 (PR #9177)
- [x] fix ICU format https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/9094 (fixed in  5267115)

fix post 2.0:
- [ ] Template Parser: Error when passing object literal as pipe parameter. #9571
- [ ] Improve Html Parser #9340 
- [ ] Opt out of translation https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/7814
- [x] Provide `NgLocalization` implementation per locale
- [ ] ICU plural format #9117 
- [ ] allow ICU messages in attributes
- [ ] implement ICU ordinal messages
- [ ] use translation strings outside of a template #11405
